characterDescription: Sir Gais Wyrm, the young adult knight in the exact Image 1: fair skin, the same short richly rust-red tousled hair and asymmetrical fringe, subtle crown tufts, narrow amber-brown eyes, youthful fine angular jaw, straight brows, clean-shaven face. Preserve his precise illustrated anime linework, sharp restrained cel shading, warm original palette and age; no beard, longer hair, muscular adult redesign or different eye shape. Preserve the dark charcoal/black plate armor, modest thin gold edging, rounded dark pauldrons, high black gorget, gold/yellow central breastplate with the BLACK Wyrm dragon, black sleeves and black gloves from the source. Extend the original armor down to waist/upper thighs with a practical belt, retaining its exact design. Do not replace the avatar armor with a chainmail-only outfit from an older equipment entry. No helmet, shield, horse, sword or extra weapon.

panels.gesture: Eyes narrowed in cool concentration, mouth closed firmly; two separated gloved hands guide the same lance into an oblique forward thrust beside torso, rear grip near hip, face clear.
A faint smug one-sided smile, assessing eyes; slight torso turn, both hands pull one continuous shaft close to hip in a controlled feint, not a giant overhead chop.
Firm drawn brows and open mouth in a short controlled exertion; rear hand drives forward, lead hand stabilizes one long lance aimed offscreen below shoulder, source face proportions preserved.
Composed unwavering look, lips pressed; both hands braced apart around one horizontal shaft below chin, elbows modestly bent to absorb a hypothetical blow.
One brow lifted with alert concern and slightly parted lips; continuous shaft diagonally beside shoulder, two hands holding practical leverage points, no shaft through his face.
Sideward focused gaze, chin tucked slightly; torso angled in a small lateral adjustment, both hands hold lance low and outward in a measured ready guard.
The uploaded avatar's restrained arrogant calm, half-lidded eyes and a subtle closed-mouth hint of a smile; LEFT hand supports the upright lance, RIGHT hand relaxed at belt, weight easy.

Confident direct amber-brown gaze, slightly raised brow; RIGHT gloved index finger points at the unseen opponent beside the camera while LEFT hand supports the long upright shaft, a readable normal-sized hand.

Small bruise on cheek and a shallow scratch, dusty armor and tired narrowed eyes; LEFT hand steadies the lance as RIGHT gloved hand presses ribs, shoulders slightly uneven, restrained pain in mouth. No blood-soaked damage or new armor design.
